purpose: Teach: フェルナンド/クルス/ヴェルディ/サダム/リヨン/スコープ/アグリ/ドーン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「スペインのフェルナンド王の絵本を読もう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was talking about reading you a picture book about King Ferdinand of Spain.
lines.style: Soft, conversational tone. Mild warmth as she shares what she's learned. Natural pacing, like she's passing along something she found charming.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとペネロペ・クルス出演の映画観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched a movie with Dad that had Penélope Cruz in it.
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick but not rushed. The excitement of having done something with Dad and wanting to share it. Small, genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヴェルディのオペラ「アイーダ」を聴かせて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to let you listen to Verdi's opera Aida with him.
lines.style: Tender, almost reverent. She's noticing the pattern—the things his father shares. Gentle pace. Slight lift at the end, like she's pleased for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「サダム政権」の社会科の宿題したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I did my social studies homework with Dad about the Saddam regime.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, uncomplaining. The everyday pride of having learned something with his father. Slight hesitation on 'Saddam'—it's a heavier word for a six-year-old to carry.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフランスのリヨンの旅行記を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is reading a travel journal about Lyon, France.
lines.style: Unhurried, thoughtful. She's savoring these details he shares. Warm acknowledgment. Like she's collecting small proofs of what his father does when Sho isn't looking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに望遠スコープの使い方を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me how to use a telescope.
lines.style: Wonder-struck but calm. The weight of having been taught something. Respectful. Lingering slightly on 'telescope'—it's a thing adults know, and he's been shown how.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアグリ、つまり農業体験イベントに連れて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is taking you to an agricultural experience event.
lines.style: Brightening on 'agricultural.' She's noticed his father opens the world. Conversational, light. A small, genuine smile—this one's special.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ドーン・オブ・ザ・デッド」の予告編観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched the trailer for Dawn of the Dead with Dad.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact excitement. Not scared—just excited he included him in something grown-up feeling. Quick, unguarded. The smallest note of pride that Dad trusts him with it.
